sentences.en: We did this thing together.

sentences.en: But I really wasn't, I wasn't, like I said, I wasn't big on sitting down and watching a game.
sentences.zh: 但我真的……就像我说的，我对坐着看比赛一点兴趣也没有。

sentences.en: It wasn't like no big-ass tradition that we did where everybody come through on Sunday and watch the games or, you know, Monday nights.
sentences.zh: 我们家可没有什么大家族传统，比如什么周日所有人聚在一起看比赛啊，或者周一晚上看球之类的。

sentences.zh: 没有什么‘我们今晚必须看周四夜赛’这种说法。

sentences.en: Nah, I wouldn't, you know, shit like that.
sentences.zh: 没有，我才不搞那套呢。

sentences.en: And then the opportunity to go to college and, you know, play there, I thought it would all end for me after high school.

sentences.en: So, and then, you know, we started sending letters like, oh, yeah, you got opportunity to go to college and shit.
sentences.zh: 然后呢，你知道的，我们开始收到信件，说什么“哦，你有机会去上大学打球了”之类的话。

sentences.en: That wasn't something that was, you know, really talked about in my household as well.

sentences.en: So.

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: What's that, schoolwork?
sentences.zh: 那是啥，功课？

sentences.zh: 对，绝对的。

sentences.zh: 肯定的。

sentences.en: Really into schoolwork?
sentences.zh: 对功课非常热衷？

sentences.en: Yeah, man, they, they, I'll say they took on the jobs of the, uh, of the teachers by, uh, making sure I maintained, uh, you know, a reasonable, uh,
sentences.zh: 对啊，兄弟，他们，他们，我可以说他们承担了，呃，老师的工作，呃，确保我能保持，呃，你知道的，一个合理的，呃，

sentences.en: grade point average to even be able to give college an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 平均绩点，甚至能够拥有上大学的机会。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But then once it was like, once I got there and, you know, seeing what type of time they was on, what I had to do in order to accomplish, you know, going to the next level,
sentences.zh: 但一旦，就像，一旦我到了那里，你知道的，看到他们是什么状态，我为了实现，你知道的，去到下一个阶段必须要做什么，

sentences.en: then shit just made sense.
sentences.zh: 然后这事就完全说得通了。

sentences.en: And it was like, that shit clicked, because now it was like, oh, I gotta, I gotta go, and I gotta do X, Y, and Z to accomplish this.
sentences.zh: 就像是，那感觉对了，因为现在就像是，哦，我得，我得去，我得做甲、乙、丙来达成这个目标。

sentences.en: Then let me just do what I need to do and see how far I could take, you know.
sentences.zh: 那我就做我需要做的事，看看我能走到多远，你知道的。

sentences.zh: 比如，哦，你踢足球开始得那么早吗？

sentences.en: Oh, sorry for him.
sentences.zh: 哦，替他感到遗憾。

sentences.en: Were you don't, were you don't remember it?
sentences.zh: 你是不是不，你是不是不记得了？

sentences.zh: 你开始的时候太小以至于不记得了吗？

sentences.en: Or, or, or, or do you remember, like, because, uh, you know, I, I never was allowed to play football.
sentences.zh: 还是，还是，还是说，你还记得，因为，呃，你知道，我，我从来没被允许踢过美式橄榄球。

sentences.en: My mom was British, she, uh, she wanted me to play soccer, um, and, but I got this one part in a football movie where I actually got to put on pads and a helmet, and I played,
sentences.zh: 我妈妈是英国人，她，呃，她想让我踢英式足球，嗯，但我接拍了橄榄球电影里的一个角色，我真的戴上了护具和头盔，我踢了，

sentences.en: like, a defensive back or something.
sentences.zh: 比如，一个防守后卫什么的。

sentences.en: And this one, this one, this one take, uh, I had to tackle a guy, and I didn't know what to do with my head.
sentences.zh: 在这一条，这一条，这一条里，呃，我必须去擒抱一个人，而我不知道该拿我的头怎么办。

sentences.en: I felt like, well, if my head hits that person's shoulder, it's gonna break my neck.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，好吧，如果我的头撞到那个人肩膀上，会把我的脖子撞断的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So what I thought would be smart to do is just to kind of shrug my shoulders up and trap my helmet in the hole that the shoulder pads create so it's locked in there.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时觉得聪明的做法是耸起肩膀，把头盔卡进护肩形成的空隙里，这样它就锁在里面了。

sentences.en: Like a turtle.
sentences.zh: 像只乌龟一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: I'm not sure, I'm not sure when you, I'm not sure when you did this, this, uh, this role in that movie, but you sound like you, you got that move from the little giants.
sentences.zh: 我不确定，我不确定你是什么时候，我不确定你是什么时候拍那部电影里的这个角色的，但听起来你，你这招是从《小巨人》里学来的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.zh: 话虽如此，杰伊，我不会那么想，确实如此，因为，马肖恩，我和你正好相反。

sentences.en: I'd rather watch it than play it, and, uh, cause I played it when I was a kid, I was terrible, but I, when I watch it, though, when I see the heads hit the bodies,
sentences.zh: 我宁愿看也不想踢，而且，呃，因为我小时候踢过，我踢得太烂了，但是，当我看着的时候，当我看到脑袋撞击身体时，

sentences.en: I think the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我想的也是一样。

sentences.en: I was like, how does their neck, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我就想，他们的脖子怎么，对啊。

sentences.zh: 对，那你还记得那个过程吗？

sentences.zh: 这里面是不是有一个很痛苦的学习曲线，还是说你当时太小了？

sentences.en: Most definitely, uh, so, I mean, I got the, I probably got the latest start out of it, cause it's,
sentences.zh: 当然啦，呃，所以，我的意思是，我大概是里面开始得最晚的，因为，

sentences.en: it was a group of us, and I mean, you know, it was more family, um, you know, close friends, like, in the neighborhood, and, uh, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们是一群人，我的意思是，你知道的，更多是家人，嗯，你知道的，好朋友，就像在街区里一样，呃，你知道的，

sentences.en: I think I was probably one of the later ones that started maybe around age 13.
sentences.zh: 我想我大概是比较晚开始的一个，差不多13岁左右。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So a few of them started maybe age six, six, eight was around the normal time for them to start, so they were called, like, considered the veterans.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当中有些人可能6岁就开始了，6岁、8岁是他们开始的正常年龄，所以他们被称为，呃，算是老兵。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And, you know, one of my closest friends, rest in peace, we were doing hitting drills, angling, tackling, it's the biggest thing in football, and, uh.

sentences.en: Is what, is angle tackling?

sentences.zh: 角度，擒抱，擒抱训练。

sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: Uh-huh.

sentences.en: This was my, my first year, my first year in full contact, uh, uh, sports, and, um, somehow he, he convinced me to go first,
sentences.zh: 这是我的第一年，我参加全接触运动的第一年，然后，不知怎么的，他，他劝我打头阵，

sentences.en: which, you know what I mean, was not a, a good idea, but, uh, so he called go, and we ran and we hit.
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思，这其实不是个好主意，但是，他喊了开始，我们就冲过去撞在了一起。

sentences.en: Like, like a couple of rams hitting each other with their horns, right?
sentences.zh: 就像，就像两只公羊用角互撞一样，对吧？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right, like Frankenstein.
sentences.zh: 对，就像科学怪人一样。

sentences.zh: 然后他直接把肚子，没错，他直接把头盔顶到了我的肚子上。

sentences.en: Ouch.
sentences.zh: 哎哟。

sentences.en: Like, ooh, shit, I don't know.

sentences.en: And I had to make a decision because, uh, as soon as, you know what I mean, as soon as he had hit me, all you can hear is the coach is like,

sentences.en: man, what the hell y'all doing?

sentences.en: Like, line up.
sentences.zh: 快排好队。

sentences.en: And I'm like, line up?
sentences.zh: 我心想，排队？

sentences.en: Like, oh, you want me to do this again?
sentences.zh: 就像是，噢，你想让我再来一次？

sentences.en: I'm laying down.
sentences.zh: 我正躺在地上呢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You want me to do this again right after?
sentences.zh: 你马上又想让我再来一次？

sentences.en: I just, I'm like, I don't know what to say.
sentences.zh: 我当时就，我不知道该说什么好。

sentences.en: Because I want to tell him, like, hey, you know I just went.
sentences.zh: 因为我想告诉他，嘿，你知道我刚刚才上过。

sentences.en: But then, you know, everybody in line, they, hey, line up, line up.
sentences.zh: 但接着，你知道的，排队的每个人都在喊，嘿，排好队，排好队。

sentences.en: You got to line it up, coach.
sentences.zh: 你得列队站好，教练。

sentences.en: You see?
sentences.zh: 你看？

sentences.en: I'm like, so I'm like, oh, you want me to do this again?
sentences.zh: 我心想，噢，你想让我再来一次？

sentences.en: So it was like, oh, hell no.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时就觉得，见鬼去吧。

sentences.en: I seen what you just did to me.
sentences.zh: 我都看到你刚才对我做了什么了。

sentences.en: And I was like, all right.
sentences.zh: 我心想，好吧。

sentences.en: Now this time, I'm going to duck my shoulder in my head and run it into you.
sentences.zh: 这次我得把肩膀和头缩起来，直接朝你撞过去。

sentences.en: So the thing was, I was a little faster than him, so I was able to get to the point quicker than him.
sentences.zh: 所以情况是，我比他稍微快一点，所以我能比他更快到达交汇点。

sentences.en: So in the midst of him lowering his helmet and his shoulders, I had already been lowered and smashing.
sentences.zh: 于是在他放低头盔和肩膀的时候，我已经放低重心并撞了上去。

sentences.en: Bam!
sentences.zh: 砰！

sentences.en: Coach is like, oh, okay, the little rookie got something to him.
sentences.zh: 教练说，噢，好吧，这个菜鸟还挺有两下子的。

sentences.en: Line up again.
sentences.zh: 再来排队。

sentences.en: And now he's calling all his veterans to the front of the line.
sentences.zh: 现在他把所有的老队员都叫到了队伍最前面。

sentences.zh: 现在他想看菜鸟和所有老队员对撞。

sentences.en: And so it was a thing of like, oh, this is just what you got to do in order to be, you know, a hitter on the team.

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh, shit.
sentences.zh: 我心想，噢，操。

sentences.en: So if I become a hitter, then I could be one of them.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我成了硬汉，那我也可以成为他们中的一员。

sentences.en: And then, I mean, you know, my first position I played, offensive line.
sentences.zh: 然后，我的意思是，你知道的，我打的第一个位置是进攻线。

sentences.en: So that's where all my little, I guess my toughness and all that, ain't afraid to hit somebody.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我那些，我猜我的强悍劲儿什么的来源，我不怕撞人。

sentences.en: And then, you know, as much as, so for y'all who don't know, I'm an offensive player.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，尽管如此，对于你们这些不知道的人来说，我是一名进攻球员。

sentences.en: But my mentality is defense.
sentences.zh: 但我的心态是防守型的。

sentences.en: And we will be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And now back to the show.
sentences.zh: 现在我们回到节目中。

sentences.en: By playing offensive line first, do you have, do you have sympathy for the offensive lineman that once you became a running back, power back,

sentences.zh: 你还记得以前跑卫对你做那种事的时候吗？

sentences.en: I'll bet it hurts.
sentences.zh: 我敢说那一定很疼。
